Alger, 10 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 10, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Minister of Post and Telecommunications, Sid Ali Zerrouki, highlighted Algerian investments in network resilience and Africa's connectivity during the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference in Doha.
Efforts algériens en matière de résilien: Algerian efforts regarding resilience and African connectivity
Le ministre de la Poste et des Télécommu: The Minister of Post and Telecommunications, Sid Ali Zerrouki, presented in Doha, during the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) Plenipotentiary Conference (PP-26), Algeria's efforts and investments regarding the resilience of networks and the connectivity of the African continent. This participation is part of the proceedings bringing together 194 member states.
Au cours d'un dialogue ministériel de ha: During a high-level ministerial dialogue focused on the resilience of telecommunications networks and services, Mr. Zerrouki detailed the actions of the Algerian state and the resources dedicated to telecommunications infrastructure. The objective is to ensure service continuity and national sovereignty over the networks.
Il a également mentionné les investissem: He also mentioned Algerian investments aimed at strengthening connectivity with other African countries, specifically citing the trans-Saharan fiber optic backbone project. On the sidelines of the conference, the minister held bilateral meetings with his counterparts from China, South Africa, the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Bahamas, and Estonia, as well as with representatives from ICANN.
